metadata.source: Only token usage metadata returned by the LLM API through the AI SDK generateText() usage object. No tokenizer, library-estimated, or prompt-string token counts are used.
notes: tokenTotals are sums of reported API fields only. Missing fields are not inferred from other fields.
usageMetadata contains the full usage object captured for that evaluation, including provider raw usage when the provider returns it.
usageMetadataSource is legacy-api-token-fields only for older cached results that predate full usage metadata capture.
